copy.description: Tired of carrying a separate water dish on every walk? This portable water cup has a built-in drinking bowl, so your dog can drink right from the cup without an extra dish. The container is leak-proof, so water stays out of your bag. It has a comfortable wrist strap that makes it easy to carry on daily walks, travel, hiking, and park visits. It is lightweight. Keep one in the car, in your bag, or by the door so it is ready for your next outing. Its simple design makes it an easy add to the walk routine. Each order includes one water cup.

faq.q: Does it come in different sizes?

Material varies by version (metal and plastic versions are offered by the maker); the version you receive is shown at checkout. Every version has a built-in drinking bowl.
Estimate: 3–7 business days to the US, plus processing 1–3 days.
